description: Combine ff5d40's 32-warp cooperative NB16 panel/transpose core with ab6f034's multi-epoch stationary-TMEM trailing slab and overlapped V/T prefetch, preserving the fast panel reductions while amortizing bulk compact-WY loads/stores in one fused n=512 megakernel.

Combined ff5d40's 32-warp cooperative NB16 panel/T core with ab6f034's multi-epoch stationary TMEM slab in one 1024-thread CTA per matrix. Warps 0-3 retain columns 384:512 across the first 24 panels and apply plain-TF32 tcgen05 transforms while warps 4-31 concurrently update columns below 384; one catch-up flush precedes panel 384. All official, differential, invariance, and off-grid guards pass. Dense n512 improved from ff5d40 18684.613 to 16218.032 us (13.20%); full geomean improved from 1442.636776 to 1424.905324 us.

Focused NCU of the full-valid combined commit failed before kernel launch because the profiler's sudo child could load libnvrtc.so.13 but not libnvrtc-builtins.so.13.0 after dropping the venv CUDA 13 library directory. The prior nsys capture succeeded at 15.926 ms fused-kernel time; retrying the unchanged commit with the cu13 library directory explicitly forwarded.

Reserved four of each 32 near-column ownership slots for the tcgen warpgroup so warps 0-3 could join the SIMT update after completing the stationary transform, while warps 4-31 began immediately. Full validation and all guards pass. Dense n512 regressed from 16218.032 to 16614.864 us (+2.45%) and geomean from 1424.905324 to 1428.761481; the delayed reserved columns show the stationary group is later than the 28-warp near update.

Restored the 28-warp/4-warp overlap and flushed the stationary slab after panel 336, routing panels 352 and 368 through the original all-32-warp FP32 SIMT update. This removes 50 late tcgen05 MMAs. Full validation and all guards pass. Dense n512 measured 16302.464 us, 0.52% slower than the 16218.032-us full-24-epoch stationary path; geomean was 1428.796571 amid unrelated-route variance, so the last two stationary epochs remain cheaper than two full slab updates.

Restored all 24 stationary epochs and reordered the short rank-16 correction to stage each 128x8 W slice once, fill Blackwell tcgen05 collector::a, reuse it for the middle two 128-row C slices, and lastuse it on the fourth. This cuts correction A staging 4x while preserving exact arithmetic. Full validation and all guards pass. Dense n512 improved from 16218.032 to 16174.066 us (0.27%); full geomean was effectively neutral/slightly better at 1424.884656 versus 1424.905324.

Replaced per-K four-warp W staging and two 128-thread named barriers with one producer warp, four rotating shared B stages, warp synchronization, and one final 128-thread join before tcgen commit. Full validation plus all guards pass, proving the four-stage operand lifetime safe, but dense n512 regressed from collector trial 16174.066 to 16446.036 us (+1.68%) and geomean to 1429.032522; four-warp staging throughput outweighs the removed barriers.

Restored all four W producer warps, retained four rotating shared B stages, and removed the post-MMA named barrier so each slice has only the producer-ready barrier before lane0 issues the naturally pipelined tcgen05 MMA. Full validation and all guards pass. Dense n512 improved from collector trial 16174.066 to 16077.039 us (0.60%) and from initial combine 16218.032 by 0.87%; full geomean was 1427.070824 amid untouched-route variance.

Added two disjoint activation stages and four disjoint B stages for the eight rank-16 correction MMAs, preserving collector fill/use/lastuse while removing the post-MMA barrier for each 128-row slice. Full validation and all guards pass. Dense n512 measured 16111.164 us versus 16077.039 us for the W-only rotating pipeline (+0.21%, within noise); geomean was 1425.964105, so correction barrier removal did not reproduce the W-side gain.

Packed the active live panel once per epoch into a 31 KiB tcgen K-major B slab using all 1024 threads, then let lane0 issue the entire TMEM-A W projection without any per-K producer barriers. Full validation and all guards pass. Dense n512 measured 16147.808 us, 0.44% slower than the 16077.039-us four-warp rotating-stage best; full geomean 1426.169712. The zero-barrier projection gain was offset by a CTA-wide pack barrier delaying all 28 near-update warps.

Moved the active-panel tcgen B prepack entirely into the lower four stationary warps, overlapping it with the upper 28 warps' near-column update. One 128-thread barrier replaces every per-K W barrier, then lane0 issues the full projection from the immutable 31 KiB slab. Full validation and all guards pass. Dense n512 reached a new best 16062.250 us (0.09% over rotating-stage 16077.039; 0.96% over initial combine 16218.032), and full geomean reached a new best 1424.239228.

Kept the overlapped four-warp active-panel prepack but restored the compact one-A/one-B correction workspace and post-correction barriers, removing four extra stages. Full validation and all guards pass. Dense n512 reached a new best 16022.611 us, 0.25% faster than 16062.250 and 1.20% faster than initial combine; full geomean measured 1425.884850 amid unrelated-route variance.

Doubled active-panel prepack from four to eight warps. Warps 8-31 start 24 near-column ownership slots immediately, warps 4-7 join slots 24-27 after pack, and warps 0-3 launch stationary tcgen. Full validation passed. Dense n=512 16039.156 us versus 16022.611 us (+0.10%, neutral/slight regression); four-warp prepack remains better.

Restored four-warp overlap and rewrote active-panel tcgen B prepack as unrolled inner-column, row-strided loops, eliminating runtime division/modulo per packed element. Full 22-test validation, differential, invariance, and off-grid guards passed. Best aggregate geomean 1421.811815 us; targeted dense n=512 was 16106.290 us versus trial 10 at 16022.611 us (+0.52%), so trial 10 remains the dense winner.

Completed the requested true megakernel combination. Starting from ff5d40, the n=512 launch remains one 1024-thread CTA per matrix with its 32-warp NB16 panel/Gram/T core and tiled input/output transpose; warps 0-3 retain trailing columns 384:512 in stationary TMEM for panels 0:368 while warps 4-31 concurrently update near columns, then one flush rejoins the original path before panel 384. The stationary path uses plain-TF32 tcgen05 W projection/correction and an overlapped four-warp immutable 31 KiB active-panel prepack, replacing per-K producer barriers. All successful candidates passed the official 22 tests plus differential, invariance, and off-grid guards. Best requested dense n=512 commit is 2eab4be7b: 16022.611 us, 14.25% faster than ff5d40 parent 18684.613 us and 1.20% faster than initial combined trial 16218.032 us; its nsys fused-kernel time is 15.785641 ms. Best aggregate/final commit is ab1ca208c0: geomean 1421.811815 us versus ff5d40 1442.636776 us (1.44% lower), dense n=512 16106.290 us, with final nsys showing one fused kernel at 15.818626 ms (99.7% GPU time). Trial evidence: reserving late near-column slots regressed 2.45%, early slab flush regressed 0.52%, one-warp W staging regressed 1.68%, four rotating W stages reached 16077.039 us, CTA-wide prepack delayed near warps, lower-four-warp overlapped prepack reached 16062.250 us, compact correction staging produced the 16022.611-us dense winner, and eight prepack warps were slightly worse. Initial NCU found 64 regs/thread, 50% theoretical occupancy, 3.56 MB spills, 60.1% no-eligible cycles, and 35.3% CTA-barrier stalls. Profiles are under autocuda/profiles/2026-07-06-18-24-02, including trial-0 NCU, trial-10 nsys, and final trial-12 nsys. Most promising remaining work: eliminate the shared B prepack entirely with a verified tcgen05 transpose-B/MN-major descriptor for panel_v, then attack the launch-bound panel barrier/spill chain; a compressed dual stationary slab or asynchronous bulk prepack is a secondary direction. No leaderboard submission was made, as instructed.
